title: IMF驻华代表说透：内需偏弱，财政发力还不够
speaker: Marshall Mills

segments.en: So the key challenge for China right now is weak domestic demand.
segments.zh: 所以中国目前的关键挑战是内需偏弱。

segments.en: And so, part of our advice is to stimulate the economy in the near term.
segments.zh: 因此，我们的建议之一是短期内提振经济。

segments.en: The key tool would be fiscal policy, so fiscal expansion.
segments.zh: 关键工具是财政政策，即财政扩张。

segments.en: It could be supported by monetary policy being increasingly accommodative.
segments.zh: 货币政策可以越来越宽松来配合。

segments.en: And so this, as you said, I haven't looked at the details since we're here in Shanghai,
segments.zh: 正如你所说，我在上海还没看到细节，

segments.en: but this is a direction that we support easing monetary policy and support of overall stimulus.
segments.zh: 但这是我们支持的方向：宽松货币政策以支持整体刺激。

segments.en: And moving towards a more interest rate-based monetary policy framework, so those are both
segments.zh: 并转向更以利率为基础的货币政策框架，这两点

segments.en: welcome factors.
segments.zh: 都是受欢迎的。

segments.en: So on the fiscal side, they did make a move, I believe, a week or so ago, at the municipal
segments.zh: 财政方面，他们大约一周前确实采取了行动，在市级

segments.en: level or the provincial level because their coffers are pretty strained right now, especially
segments.zh: 或省级层面，因为他们的财政资金目前相当紧张，尤其是

segments.en: several years ago through the COVID expenditures.
segments.zh: 几年前因疫情支出。

segments.en: But that's probably not enough to get the structural changes that we need at the household and
segments.zh: 但这可能不足以带来我们所需的家庭和

segments.en: business confidence up.
segments.zh: 企业信心提升。

segments.en: Well, it's certainly a step in the right direction.
segments.zh: 嗯，这当然是朝着正确方向迈出的一步。

segments.en: And it was a fairly broad package of fiscal stimulus, including increasing the quotas for
segments.zh: 这是一个相当广泛的财政刺激方案，包括增加

segments.en: local government borrowing.
segments.zh: 地方政府借款额度。

segments.en: But by tapping unused quotas from the past, which shows the need to move faster, as well
segments.zh: 但动用过去未使用的额度，这表明需要更快行动，以及

segments.en: as accelerating the execution of the budget, and some easing of a PBC credit facility interest
segments.zh: 加快预算执行，以及央行信贷工具利率的一些宽松，

segments.en: rate.
segments.zh: 利率。

segments.en: So all together, very welcome.
segments.zh: 总的来说，非常受欢迎。

segments.en: We do believe that more urgent and forceful action is called for.
segments.zh: 我们确实认为需要更紧迫、更有力的行动。

segments.en: So a step in the right direction, what form though?
segments.zh: 所以是朝着正确方向的一步，但以什么形式？
